authority.proof_rule: A correlated point remains the unique intersection of its two transported exact supports. A nonsingular affine map preserves uniqueness and incidence; a negative exact determinant reverses every retained left/right side certificate. Offset translation preserves the construction-certified constant coordinate, so only the certified traversal axis must be compared.

policy_evidence.strict: Determinant sign, transformed axis certificates, interval separation, authored perpendicularity, and all reusable topology facts are evaluated with STRICT evidence only. Unresolved signs or orders remain typed uncertainty.
policy_evidence.approximate_512: The exact fixture follows the same proof graph and returns Certified without consuming a terminal. In the generic mixed-endpoint refinement fallback, only unresolved equality after the exact 512-step schedule may consume APPROXIMATE_512; no approximate coordinate, side, support, or direction is retained.
policy_evidence.construction_policy: Every transported chord and correlated point validates that the replay policy equals its construction policy. The public fixture is rebuilt independently for STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512.
policy_evidence.orientation_rule: The pair point computes the exact affine determinant under STRICT. Positive determinants preserve its two side arrays, negative determinants swap Left and Right, and exact zero is InvalidAffineTransform.
policy_evidence.uncertainty_rule: A determinant with no exact sign returns RealSign uncertainty even during an APPROXIMATE_512 attempt because side orientation is reusable structural evidence. STRICT coordinate refinement never promotes overlapping nonsingleton bounds to equality.
